note: Hand-authored supplements to the extracted override records. Every entry here was read off the source PDF by a human, because the extractor refuses to guess which description blocks share a merged deadline-table cell: word coordinates carry no row-boundary signal, and a guessed boundary fabricates overrides rather than missing them (docs/news/MERGED_CELL_INVESTIGATION.md). An entry supplements one extracted record and inherits that record's rdo_codes; it is dropped, never emitted unscoped, when the record it supplements is absent from the run. Re-check every entry against the printed table if its circular is amended, superseded or re-issued, and delete the entry when the circular no longer applies. Never add an eFPS-group row here: the app models non-eFPS statutory dates (locked decision L10). form_codes must be canonical app codes (scripts/news-sync/form-codes.ts); anything else is dropped and reported.
